metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Pelvic Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best exercises to quickly relieve pelvic pain — even in as little as 30 seconds!

These moves work by stretching and strengthening the pelvic floor muscles to help ease tension and provide both fast and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise targets different muscles. For best results, try them all and stick with the ones that work best for you.

Watch now and start relieving pelvic pain at home!

0:00 Intro
0:38 Bed/Floor Stretch
